title: Thompson's groups and Teichmüller modular groups of generalized Cantor sets
summary: Thompson's groups, which are denoted by $F, T$ and $V$, were introduced by R. Thompson. It is known that they are related to various fields in mathematics. In this paper, we establish that Thompson's groups are regarded as subgroups of Teichmüller modular groups of Teichmüller spaces of generalized Cantor sets. Moreover, Thompson's groups $F$ and $T$ act properly discontinuously on such Teichmüller spaces but Thompson's group $V$ does not.
